meta.title: Awesome-TCM-LLM
meta.title_zh: 开源中医模型、数据、论文、专利
meta.description_zh: 开源中医模型、数据、论文、专利精选，也带一点相关中文医疗资源。
meta.description_en: Curated open TCM models, datasets, papers, and patents, plus a few related Chinese medical resources.

items.name: 广医·岐智大模型2.0亮相2026服贸会，落地AI医生安安与六大医院场景
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院广安门医院在2026服贸会展示**广医·岐智2.0**，以AI医生「安安」覆盖患者服务、临床诊疗、病房管理等六大场景
items.summary_en: Guang'anmen Hospital shows **Guangyi Qizhi 2.0** at CIFTIS 2026, with AI doctor An'an covering six hospital scenes from patient service to ward management.

items.name: 北京中医药大学在服贸会首发展示中医体质辨识体系与具身智能推拿机器人
items.summary_zh: 2026服贸会中医药展区，北京中医药大学**首发首展**中医体质辨识体系与具身智能推拿机器人，同期还有智能诊脉设备体验
items.summary_en: Beijing University of Chinese Medicine debuts a TCM constitution-identification system and an embodied tuina robot at the CIFTIS 2026 TCM pavilion.

items.name: 上海市第七人民医院发布岐元中医大模型，支持名老中医Agent数字孪生
items.summary_zh: 上海中医药大学附属第七人民医院正式发布**岐元大模型**，采用预训练+领域微调+专家强化学习，支持生成式病历与名老中医Agent数字孪生，并亮相WAIC
items.summary_en: Shanghai Seventh People's Hospital (SHUTCM) releases the **Qiyuan** TCM LLM with pretraining, domain fine-tuning, and expert RL; supports generative medical records and master-physician Agent digital twins; showcased at WAIC.

items.name: 贵州医大等发布华族本草民族药AI大模型
items.summary_zh: 贵州医科大学等在中国—东盟教育交流周发布全国首个民族药创制全域智能平台**华族本草**，以数智岐黄+Qwen为底座融汇多民族医药古籍
items.summary_en: Guizhou Medical University and partners launch **HuaZu BenCao**, a national ethnic-medicine AI platform built on ShuZhi QiHuang + Qwen integrating multi-ethnic materia medica classics.

items.name: 安顿七诊合参中医机器人与天回大模型亮相WAIC 2026
items.summary_zh: 安顿健康在WAIC 2026首发**七诊合参**中医机器人，集成面/红外面/舌/耳/闻/问/脉采集，底座含天回脉诊算法与中医诊疗大模型
items.summary_en: Andun Health debuts a **seven-diagnosis** TCM robot at WAIC 2026, integrating face/IR face/tongue/ear/auscultation/inquiry/pulse sensing with TianHui pulse algorithms and a TCM clinical LLM.

items.name: 智慧眼砭石多模态中医大模型亮相WAIC 2026
items.summary_zh: 智慧眼携**砭石云中医**亮相WAIC 2026，以已备案砭石多模态大模型为底座，展示四诊仪与辅助诊疗系统
items.summary_en: Insightful Eye presents **Bianshi Cloud TCM** at WAIC 2026, built on a registered Bianshi multimodal model with four-diagnosis devices and assisted-care systems.

items.name: 中科闻歌通过港交所上市聆讯；报道提及与中国中医科学院合作的大医金匮中医大模型已通
items.summary_zh: 中科闻歌通过港交所上市聆讯；报道提及与中国中医科学院合作的**大医金匮**中医大模型已通过中国信通院最高级别可信AI认证
items.align_note: 大医金匮聆讯措辞已按核验修正
items.summary_en: Zhongke Wenge passes HKEX listing hearing; reports note the **DaYi JinKui** TCM LLM (with CACMS) has obtained top-tier CAICT Trusted AI certification.

items.name: 北京中医药大学牵头研发的薪火中国药中医药教育大模型通过国家生成式人工智能服务备案
items.summary_zh: 北京中医药大学牵头研发的**薪火中国药**中医药教育大模型通过国家生成式人工智能服务备案，成为国内首个获批面向公众服务的中医药领域大模型
items.summary_en: Beijing University of Chinese Medicine's **XinHuo ZhongGuoYao** TCM education LLM completes national generative-AI service filing—the first publicly approved TCM-domain model of its kind.

items.name: 山东启动智汇岐黄中医药大模型重点场景项目
items.summary_zh: 山东中医药大学附属医院启动山东省卫健委「人工智能＋」中医药重点场景**智汇岐黄**大模型项目
items.summary_en: Affiliated Hospital of Shandong University of TCM launches the provincial AI+ TCM scenario project **ZhiHui QiHuang**.

items.name: 八部门印发中药工业高质量发展实施方案提出AI与知识图谱赋能
items.summary_zh: 工信部等八部门印发《中药工业高质量发展实施方案（2026—2030年）》，明确运用人工智能与知识图谱赋能经典名方与名老中医经验方研发
items.summary_en: Eight ministries issue the TCM Industry High-Quality Development Plan (2026–2030), calling for AI and knowledge graphs to empower classical formulas and master physicians' prescriptions.

items.name: 吉林发布众星·长白岐黄1.0 AI原生多模态中医药大模型
items.summary_zh: 吉林发布**众星·长白岐黄1.0** AI原生多模态中医药大模型
items.summary_en: Jilin releases **ZhongXing·Changbai Qihuang 1.0**, an AI-native multimodal TCM LLM.

items.name: 固生堂发布”中医大脑”产品及国医大师施杞教授AI数字分身，已累计发布14位顶级专
items.summary_zh: 固生堂发布”中医大脑”产品及国医大师施杞教授AI数字分身，已累计发布14位顶级专家数字分身，覆盖八大中医核心专科
items.summary_en: Gushengtang launches a “TCM Brain” product and AI digital twin of National TCM Master Shi Qi; 14 expert twins cover eight core specialties.

items.name: 智明堂ZMT-M1在国家中医执业医师资格考试模拟测试中以96.26分获得该领域最
items.summary_zh: **智明堂ZMT-M1**在国家中医执业医师资格考试模拟测试中以96.26分获得该领域最佳成绩，已在全国100余间诊室试点应用
items.summary_en: **ZMT-M1** scores 96.26 on a simulated national TCM practitioner exam and is piloted in 100+ clinics.

items.name: 国家卫健委等五部门印发《关于促进和规范”人工智能+医疗卫生”应用发展的实施意见》
items.summary_zh: 国家卫健委等五部门印发《关于促进和规范”人工智能+医疗卫生”应用发展的实施意见》，明确支撑建设中医药诊疗大模型
items.summary_en: Five national health ministries issue AI+ healthcare guidelines that explicitly support building TCM diagnostic LLMs.

items.name: 传神语联任度·素问通过中国信通院可信AI中医药大模型4+级评估
items.summary_zh: 传神语联**任度·素问**通过中国信通院可信AI中医药大模型4+级评估
items.summary_en: Transn's **RenDu·SuWen** passes CAICT Trusted AI TCM LLM Level 4+ evaluation.

items.name: 智赋岐黄天功中医AI大模型通过国家深度合成服务算法备案，应用于中医四诊仪与体质辨
items.summary_zh: **智赋岐黄天功**中医AI大模型通过国家深度合成服务算法备案，应用于中医四诊仪与体质辨识
items.summary_en: **ZhiFu Qihuang Tiangong** TCM AI model completes national deep-synthesis algorithm filing for four-diagnosis devices and constitution assessment.

items.name: 伊尹中医经典大模型在河南嵩县启用
items.summary_zh: 中原药谷基层中医药振兴工程下，**伊尹中医经典大模型**在嵩县发布启用，融合中医教育与AI辅助诊疗服务县域基层
items.summary_en: **YiYin** classical TCM LLM goes live in Song County, Henan, combining TCM education with AI-assisted care for county clinics.

items.name: 固生堂正式发布十大”国医AI分身”，基于国医大师及名中医临床经验构建，辨证准确性
items.summary_zh: **固生堂**正式发布十大”国医AI分身”，基于国医大师及名中医临床经验构建，辨证准确性达86%以上
items.summary_en: **Gushengtang** releases ten “National Master AI twins” trained on master clinicians' experience, reporting >86% pattern-differentiation accuracy.

items.name: 天河·灵枢中医药大模型2.0与智能模型评价体系发布
items.summary_zh: 国家超算天津中心联合天津中医药大学等发布**天河·灵枢**2.0，由针灸专科扩展至20余科；同步启动中医药智能模型评价体系
items.summary_en: NSCC-TJ and Tianjin University of TCM release **TianHe·LingShu** 2.0 (expanded beyond acupuncture to 20+ specialties) and launch a TCM intelligent-model evaluation system.

items.name: 广安门医院成立广医·岐智大模型智能体联盟
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院广安门医院与多家医联体单位成立**广医·岐智大模型智能体联盟**，推进跨机构智能诊疗能力辐射
items.summary_en: Guang'anmen Hospital forms the **GuangYi·QiZhi** LLM agent alliance with medical consortium partners for cross-institution intelligent care.

items.name: 中医横琴垂类大模型正式发布
items.summary_zh: **中医横琴**垂类大模型正式发布
items.summary_en: **TCM Hengqin** vertical LLM is officially released.

items.name: 中国中医科学院发布中医药大模型评测标准
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院发布中医药大模型评测标准
items.summary_en: China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences releases evaluation standards for TCM large models.

items.name: 传神语联发布任度·素问中医大模型，基于全自研混合熵(moH)技术架构，支持智能问
items.summary_zh: 传神语联发布**任度·素问**中医大模型，基于全自研混合熵(moH)技术架构，支持智能问诊、辨证分析、方剂推荐
items.summary_en: Transn releases **RenDu·SuWen** TCM LLM (mixture-of-entropy architecture) for inquiry, pattern differentiation, and formula recommendation.

items.name: 中国中医科学院广安门医院28日正式发布广医·岐智中医大模型，成为国内首家本地化部
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院广安门医院28日正式发布**广医·岐智**中医大模型，成为国内首家本地化部署”算力+模型+应用”一体化服务的中医医院
items.summary_en: Guang'anmen Hospital releases **GuangYi·QiZhi**, described as the first TCM hospital with integrated local compute + model + application deployment.

items.name: 招联联合中山大学与广中医深圳医院发布仲思中医大模型
items.summary_zh: 招联消费金融联合中山大学、广州中医药大学深圳医院发布中医垂直大模型**仲思**，落地深圳多家社康中心智能问诊
items.summary_en: China UnionPay Consumer Finance with Sun Yat-sen University and GZUCMS Shenzhen Hospital release vertical TCM LLM **ZhongSi** for community clinic inquiry.

items.name: 中科闻歌发布大医金匮中医大模型及中医智能健康管理平台，基于1500余本中医典籍训
items.summary_zh: 中科闻歌发布**大医金匮**中医大模型及中医智能健康管理平台，基于1500余本中医典籍训练
items.summary_en: Zhongke Wenge releases **DaYi JinKui** TCM LLM and health platform trained on 1,500+ TCM classics.

items.name: 天士力与华为发布数智本草中医药语言与计算双模态大模型
items.summary_zh: 天士力与华为云联合发布**数智本草**大模型，基于盘古语言与药物分子模型，覆盖中药研发全链条；后通过信通院中医药大模型4+级评估
items.summary_en: Tasly and Huawei Cloud release **ShuZhi BenCao** (Pangu language + molecular models) covering TCM R&D; later earns CAICT TCM LLM Level 4+.

items.name: 数智岐黄中医药大模型发布
items.summary_zh: 华东师范大学、上海中医药大学、华东理工大学、海军军医大学、临港实验室、华润江中现代中药全国重点实验室联合开发了**数智岐黄**中医药大模型。所附链接为华东师范大学对数智岐黄 2.0 的后续介绍，并非 2024.03 首发公告。
items.summary_en: ECNU, SHUTCM, ECUST, NMMU, Lingang Lab, and CR Jiangzhong jointly develop the **ShuZhi QiHuang** TCM LLM. The linked ECNU page is a later write-up of ShuZhi QiHuang 2.0, not the original 2024.03 release announcement.

items.name: 大经中医发布岐黄问道中医大模型
items.summary_zh: 南京大经中医发布**岐黄问道·大模型**，基于千万级知识图谱与临床数据，面向医疗机构开放内测
items.summary_en: Nanjing Dajing TCM releases **QiHuang Wendao** LLM with large knowledge graphs and clinical data for institutional beta use.

items.name: CORE-Acu
items.summary_zh: 针灸临床决策：结构化推理轨迹与知识图谱安全否决闭环
items.summary_en: Acupuncture clinical decision support with structured reasoning traces and a knowledge-graph safety veto loop.

items.name: DERM-3R
items.summary_zh: 资源受限下的中医皮肤病多模态多智能体框架（识别/表征/辨证论治三智能体）
items.summary_en: Resource-constrained multimodal multi-agent framework for TCM dermatology (recognition / representation / SDT agents).

items.name: GastroTCM
items.summary_zh: 中医消化内科大模型，基于Llama3-8B微调并结合RAG与智能体框架。Chinese Medicine 论文署名清华大学 TCM-X 与中日友好医院等
items.summary_en: TCM gastroenterology LLM fine-tuned from Llama3-8B with RAG and agent scaffolding. Chinese Medicine paper from Tsinghua TCM-X and China-Japan Friendship Hospital et al.

items.name: MMIR-TCM
items.summary_zh: 记忆增强的多模态舌诊与临床决策框架，提出 MedTCM 数据集与 TDEU 评测指标
items.summary_en: Memory-augmented multimodal tongue diagnosis and clinical decision framework; proposes MedTCM dataset and TDEU metric.

items.name: Qwen-TCM-Dia
items.summary_zh: 面向中医泄泻的专科微调模型（续训+CoT指令微调），覆盖症状→病机→治法→方药推理链。Digital Chinese Medicine 署名首都医科大学附属北京中医医院与北京中医药大学等
orgs: 首都医科大学附属北京中医医院
items.summary_en: Specialty fine-tuned model for TCM diarrhea care (CPT + CoT SFT) covering symptom→pathomechanism→method→formula chains. Digital Chinese Medicine authors at Beijing Hospital of TCM (CMU) and BUCM et al.
orgs_en: Beijing Hospital of TCM, Capital Medical University
Beijing University of Chinese Medicine et al.

items.name: TCM-Agent
items.summary_zh: 面向网络药理学与中药发现的 LLM 多智能体系统
items.summary_en: LLM multi-agent system for network pharmacology and herbal discovery.

items.name: TCM-DiffRAG
orgs: Guangdong Institute of Intelligence Science and Technology, Zhuhai
items.summary_zh: 通用知识图谱 + 个性化知识图谱 + CoT 的辨证推理 RAG 框架
items.summary_en: Syndrome-differentiation RAG with a general KG, a personalized KG, and chain-of-thought.

items.name: TongueVLM
items.summary_zh: 中医舌诊多模态大模型，支持舌象描述生成与体质推理。JMIR 页被拦截，OpenAlex 记录作者单位为合肥工业大学与安徽中医药大学等
items.summary_en: Multimodal VLM for TCM tongue diagnosis, description generation, and constitution reasoning. JMIR page blocked; OpenAlex lists HFUT and Anhui University of Chinese Medicine et al.
orgs_en: Anhui University of Chinese Medicine et al.

items.name: 杏核 (Xinghe)
items.summary_zh: Xinghe-TCM 基于 Qwen3.5-9B 的内经推理模型；QLoRA 后合并权重，约 2009 条内经指令，显式思维链辨证并强调不开方。HF 页无独立论文、无高校署名
items.summary_en: Xinghe-TCM Neijing reasoning model on Qwen3.5-9B (QLoRA, ~2009 instructions, no-prescription safety). HF page lists no paper and no university affiliation.

items.name: 灵兰秘典 (LingLan)
items.summary_zh: 大规模多任务中医评测基准，覆盖 5 大域、13 子任务、25624 实例
items.summary_en: Large multi-task TCM benchmark: 5 domains, 13 subtasks, 25,624 instances.

items.name: ATCMD-Bench
items.summary_zh: 首个Agentic中医诊断基准，通过多智能体模拟问诊评估LLM诊疗能力
items.summary_en: First agentic TCM diagnosis benchmark, evaluating LLMs through multi-agent simulated consultations.

items.name: 中医端到端临床支持基准
items.summary_zh: 面向端到端临床支持全链路的中医LLM评测基准
items.summary_en: Benchmark for end-to-end TCM clinical support across the full LLM care pipeline.

items.name: 青囊 (QingNangTCM)
items.summary_zh: 参数高效微调的中医问答与临床推理模型，构建10万条**QnTCM_Dataset**语料
items.summary_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuned TCM QA and clinical reasoning model; builds the 100k-item **QnTCM_Dataset**.

items.name: HerbWise
items.summary_zh: 面向传统草药（THM）的领域大模型，服务草药现代化与标准化
items.summary_en: Domain LLM for traditional herbal medicine (THM), serving herbal modernization and standardization.
orgs_en: Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine

items.name: Med-Shicheng（师承）
items.summary_zh: 基于天医 (Tianyi) 的轻量级名老中医经验传承框架，单模型内化5位国医大师知识系统、覆盖7类任务
items.summary_en: Lightweight master-physician experience-inheritance framework built on Tianyi; a single model internalizes 5 national masters' knowledge systems across 7 task types.
orgs_en: Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine et al.

items.name: DongYuan
items.summary_zh: 中西医结合脾胃病诊断LLM框架，融合中医辨证与西医诊断推理。arXiv PDF 署名河北省中医院、中科院自动化所、中科闻歌与天津大学
orgs: 中国科学院自动化研究所等
items.summary_en: Integrative spleen–stomach disease diagnosis LLM framework combining TCM pattern differentiation with Western diagnostic reasoning. arXiv PDF authors at Hebei Provincial Hospital of TCM and CASIA et al.
orgs_en: Hebei Provincial Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine
Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences et al.

items.name: MACAT
items.summary_zh: 多智能体文化感知翻译框架，实验覆盖中医经典与《论语》文化负载词英译
items.summary_en: Multi-agent culture-aware translation framework, evaluated on culture-loaded terms from TCM classics and the Analects.

items.name: TongueDx2
items.summary_zh: 舌诊深度学习设计空间系统消融研究（20+模型版本），含5109图像/976专家标注
items.summary_en: Systematic ablation of the tongue-diagnosis DL design space (20+ model variants); TongueDx2 includes 5,109 images / 976 expert annotations.

items.name: Med-Bench-Arena
items.summary_zh: 面向医学与中医药LLM/Agent的开源评测平台，支持HF/vLLM/LiteLLM、多模态与中医特色指标（ZhongJing团队）
items.summary_en: Open evaluation platform for medical and TCM LLMs/Agents (HF/vLLM/LiteLLM, multimodal, TCM-specific metrics), from the ZhongJing team.

items.name: TCMBenchEval
items.summary_zh: 基于真实临床医案的LLM中医评测基准
items.summary_en: Benchmark evaluating LLMs on real clinical TCM case records (ICIC 2026).

items.name: 舌面多模态融合智能诊断
items.summary_zh: 舌-面多模态特征融合+LLM驱动的中医智能诊断
items.summary_en: Tongue–face multimodal feature fusion with LLM-driven intelligent TCM diagnosis.

items.name: TCMI-F-6D
items.summary_zh: 中医信息学跨学科基础能力六维基准
items.summary_en: Six-dimensional benchmark of interdisciplinary foundational competence in TCM informatics.

items.name: 靳三针知识图谱问答 (Jin San Zhen KG-QA)
items.summary_zh: 靳三针针灸流派知识图谱+大模型问答工具
items.summary_en: Knowledge graph + LLM QA tool for the Jin San Zhen acupuncture school.

items.name: KDC-NER
items.summary_zh: 知识引导数据增强+大模型微调的中医嵌套命名实体识别框架
items.summary_en: Knowledge-guided data augmentation + LLM fine-tuning framework for nested NER in TCM.

items.name: TCMLLM / 灵丹 (Lingdan)
items.summary_zh: 中医药大模型与处方推荐
items.summary_en: TCMLLM / Lingdan for TCM modeling and prescription recommendation.

items.name: 灵丹-V2 (Lingdan-V2)
items.summary_zh: 北交大灵丹二代中医推理家族（Qwen3 4B/8B/14B，CPT+SFT+处方GRPO）；ModelScope有权重但需申请，未标可自由下载

items.name: DFGLM-TCM

items.name: 大数中医 (BigDataTCM)
items.summary_zh: 河南工业大学复杂性科学研究院与阿帕斯联合研发的中医垂直领域大模型（34B），提供医疗问答、诊断支持与中医知识服务
items.summary_en: BigDataTCM (34B): a vertical TCM LLM co-developed by HAUT's Complexity Science institute and Apus, offering medical QA, diagnostic support and TCM knowledge services.

items.name: 明医 (MING)
items.summary_zh: 中文医疗问诊大模型 MING，以稀疏 LoRA 混合专家（MING-MoE）增强医疗多任务学习能力（arXiv 2024）
items.align_note: ACL anthology 619 为 MedCare，明医主论文改 arXiv
items.summary_en: MING: a Chinese medical consultation LLM using a sparse mixture of low-rank adapter experts (MING-MoE) for medical multi-task learning (arXiv 2024).

items.name: 本草[原名：华驼(HuaTuo)]
items.summary_zh: 基于中文医学知识的大语言模型指令微调
items.summary_en: Instruction-tuned Chinese medical LLM (BenCao / formerly HuaTuo).

items.name: TCM-GPT
items.venue: Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine Update
items.summary_zh: 面向中医领域自适应的高效预训练大模型。期刊元数据署名北京邮电大学与伦敦大学学院
items.summary_en: Efficient pre-training of LLMs for domain adaptation in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Journal metadata lists BUPT and UCL.
orgs_en: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

items.summary_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning of ChatGLM with Chinese patent medicine instructions. Authors at Anhui University of Chinese Medicine and CACMS Anhui Computer Application Research Institute.
orgs_en: Anhui Computer Application Research Institute of Chinese Medicine, CACMS

items.name: TCM-FTP
items.summary_zh: 面向中药处方预测的大模型微调方法
items.summary_en: Fine-tuning LLMs for herbal prescription prediction.

items.summary_en: Relation extraction with LLMs — a case study on acupuncture point locations.

items.summary_zh: 比较不同国家大模型的中医表现，论证本土化模型的必要性
items.summary_en: Comparing LLMs developed in different countries on TCM; highlights language/cultural bias and the need for localized models.

items.summary_zh: 中医领域知识图谱补全与质量评估研究
items.summary_en: Domain knowledge graph completion and quality evaluation for Traditional Chinese Medicine.

items.summary_zh: 以 ChatGPT 为例探讨交互式AI应用于中医的可行性与挑战
items.summary_en: Feasibility and challenges of interactive AI for TCM, using ChatGPT as an example.

items.name: Evi-BERT
items.summary_zh: 中医RCT证据自动抽取的信息抽取模型开发与验证
items.summary_en: Automated information-extraction model (Evi-BERT) enhancing RCT evidence extraction for TCM.

items.name: ZY-BERT
items.summary_zh: TCM-SD 同文提出的中医领域预训练编码器（约 0.4B token 语料）；权重在网盘，仓库另含辨证微调代码。与 2411.00897 RLAIF 文不是同一工作
items.summary_en: Domain TCM encoder from the TCM-SD paper (~0.4B-token corpus); weights are on cloud drive, with syndrome-differentiation fine-tune code in the repo. Not the same work as arXiv 2411.00897.

items.name: TCM-BERT
items.summary_zh: 用领域语料继续预训练 BERT，把中医临床记录分成五类病（JAMIA 2019）。CKCEST 版权，全量 46205 条不公开，仓库只有划分样例和网盘微调权重
items.summary_en: BERT further pretrained on TCM clinical text for five-way disease classification (JAMIA 2019). CKCEST holds copyright; the full 46,205 records are not released, only splits plus drive-hosted fine-tuned weights.

items.name: TCM MLKG-RAG
orgs: University of Science and Technology of China
items.summary_zh: 多层知识图谱检索增强生成的中医智能诊断
items.summary_en: TCM intelligent diagnosis based on multi-layer knowledge graph retrieval-augmented generation.

items.name: TCMSF
items.summary_zh: 中医证候古籍知识图谱构建框架 TCMSF，将古籍中的证候知识系统化组织并语义关联，为中医信息化提供基础（Methods of Information in Medicine 2024）
items.summary_en: TCMSF: a construction framework for a TCM syndrome ancient-book knowledge graph that organizes syndrome knowledge from classical texts in a structured, semantically oriented way (Methods Inf. Med. 2024).

items.name: ChatGPT 中医知识理解探究
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT 对中医知识理解能力的评测
items.summary_en: Evaluating ChatGPT's comprehension of Traditional Chinese Medicine knowledge.

items.name: 中医提示工程框架
items.summary_zh: 基于提示工程框架的大语言模型中医智能理解方法
items.summary_en: Prompt-engineering framework for LLM intelligent understanding in TCM.

items.name: RLAIF 中医对齐
items.summary_zh: 通过AI反馈强化学习增强大语言模型的中医能力
items.summary_en: Enhancing LLMs' TCM capabilities through reinforcement learning from AI feedback.

items.name: PresRecST
items.summary_zh: 按「辨证—立法—荐药」递进推荐中药处方（JAMIA 2024）；配套公开 TCM-Lung 编码子集与 TCM-PD 复现表，代码在 GitHub
items.summary_en: Progressive herb-prescription recommendation following syndrome differentiation then treatment planning (JAMIA 2024); ships a public encoded TCM-Lung subset and a TCM-PD reproduction table.

items.name: TCMD
items.summary_zh: 面向大模型评测的中医执业考试选择题集（论文报告约 2851 训 / 600 测）；独立打开论文页未见官方 GitHub 或 Hugging Face 下载
items.summary_en: TCMD, a TCM licensing-exam multiple-choice set for LLM evaluation (paper reports ~2,851 train / 600 test). Independent check found no official GitHub or Hugging Face download.

items.name: BSG 中医智能问答
orgs: Hunan University of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_zh: 基于 BSG 深度学习模型的中医智能问答系统（方剂与中药实例）
items.summary_en: Intelligent QA system for TCM based on a BSG deep-learning model (prescription and materia medica cases).

items.name: ACUBERT
items.summary_zh: 针灸适应证知识库的经络实体识别与分类模型
items.summary_en: ACUBERT for meridian entity recognition and classification in acupuncture indication knowledge bases.

items.name: 中医药大模型知识增强方法
items.summary_zh: 面向中医药大模型的知识增强方法，基于约十万首经典方剂构建图谱并保持方剂结构性
items.summary_en: Knowledge augmentation for TCM LLMs — a graph built from ~100k classical formulas preserving prescription structure.

items.name: 中医标准化评估基准
items.summary_zh: 覆盖13个学科共29506道题的中医测评基准，系统评测3个通用模型与5个中文医疗模型
items.summary_en: Standardized TCM evaluation benchmark of 29,506 questions across 13 subjects; tests 3 general and 5 Chinese medical LLMs.
orgs_en: Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine

items.name: 中医药问答大语言模型
items.summary_zh: RAG 结合 P-Tuning v2 微调的中医药问答大模型（ChatGLM2-6B）
items.summary_en: TCM QA LLM combining RAG with P-Tuning v2 fine-tuning on ChatGLM2-6B.

Changchun University of Traditional Chinese Medicine

items.summary_en: GPT-4 vs mainstream Chinese LLMs on a TCM postgraduate examination dataset (preprint).

items.name: RAG 增强中医问答置信度

items.summary_en: Implementing retrieval-augmented generation to build LLM confidence in TCM (preprint).

items.summary_en: ChatMed series of Chinese medical LLMs, including ChatMed-Consult trained on 500k+ online consultation dialogues. GitHub README cites Wei Zhu and Xiaoling Wang; no standalone journal paper.

items.summary_zh: 会看胸部X光片的中文多模态医学大模型
items.summary_en: Chinese multimodal medical LLM for chest X-ray interpretation.

items.summary_zh: 中文医学语料训练的大型语言模型
orgs: 香港中文大学(深圳)，深圳市大数据研究院
items.summary_en: Large language model trained on Chinese medical corpora (HuaTuoGPT).
orgs_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

items.name: 启真医学大模型 (QiZhenGPT)
items.summary_zh: 中文医疗场景、药品知识问答、优化疾病、手术、检验等
items.summary_en: Chinese clinical QA model for drugs, diseases, procedures, and labs (QiZhenGPT).

items.name: 孙思邈 (Sunsimiao)
items.summary_zh: 孙思邈中文医疗大模型，Sunsimiao-7B 基于 Qwen2-7B 以高质量医疗数据微调，在 CMB-Exam 达 30B 量级 SOTA
items.summary_en: Sunsimiao Chinese medical LLM; Sunsimiao-7B fine-tuned from Qwen2-7B on curated medical data, reaching 30B-level SOTA on CMB-Exam.

items.name: 扁鹊 (BianQue)
items.summary_zh: 中文领域生活空间主动健康大模型
orgs: 华南理工大学，广东省数字孪生人重点实验室
items.summary_en: Chinese proactive health LLM for everyday living spaces (BianQue).
orgs_en: Guangdong Key Laboratory of Digital Twin Humans

items.name: 百川-M1 (Baichuan-M1)
items.summary_zh: 百川智能从零训练的开源医疗大模型（14B），约20万亿token医疗+通用数据，覆盖20+科室；常被后续中医微调当作底座
items.summary_en: Baichuan's from-scratch open medical LLM (14B), trained on ~20T medical+general tokens across 20+ specialties; a common base for later TCM fine-tunes.

items.summary_zh: 百川第二代开源医疗推理模型（32B，底座Qwen2.5-32B），用大规模验证器与多阶段RL做临床对话对齐，HealthBench开源前列
items.summary_en: Baichuan's second open medical reasoning model (32B on Qwen2.5-32B) with a large verifier system and multi-stage RL; strong open-source HealthBench results.

items.name: 百川-M3 (Baichuan-M3)
items.summary_zh: 百川第三代开源医疗推理模型（235B，底座Qwen3），用SPAR分段RL与事实感知RL做主动问诊和抑幻觉；HealthBench与SCAN-bench开源前列
items.summary_en: Baichuan's third open medical reasoning model (235B on Qwen3) with SPAR staged RL and fact-aware RL for active inquiry and hallucination control; strong HealthBench and SCAN-bench results.

items.name: 华佗GPT-II (HuatuoGPT-II)
items.summary_zh: 中大深圳华佗系列二代，单阶段领域适配；7B/13B以Baichuan2为底座，是中文医疗评测里最常见的开源对照之一
orgs: 香港中文大学(深圳)，深圳市大数据研究院
items.summary_en: Second HuatuoGPT generation with one-stage medical adaptation; 7B/13B use Baichuan2 backbones and remain a standard Chinese medical baseline.
orgs_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

items.name: 华佗GPT-o1 (HuatuoGPT-o1)
items.summary_zh: 华佗系列医疗复杂推理模型，用可验证医题+医学验证器做搜索微调与强化学习；7B/72B支持中英
orgs: 香港中文大学(深圳)，深圳市大数据研究院
items.summary_en: HuatuoGPT medical complex-reasoning model trained with verifiable problems and a medical verifier; 7B/72B cover Chinese and English.
orgs_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

orgs: 香港中文大学(深圳)，深圳市大数据研究院
items.summary_en: HuatuoGPT multimodal medical model that injects visual knowledge at scale; a common Chinese medical vision baseline.
orgs_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

items.summary_en: Fudan DISC conversational medical LLM on Baichuan-13B, with DISC-Med-SFT built from knowledge graphs and reconstructed consultations.

items.name: PULSE

items.summary_en: OpenMEDLab Chinese medical LLM (Bloom 7B/14B) for exams, report reading, record structuring, and simulated diagnosis.

items.summary_en: Winning Health open medical LLM on Qwen for medical QA, record understanding, and multi-turn consults; 7B/14B weights are public.

items.name: 卫宁WiNGPT3
items.summary_zh: 卫宁第三代医疗推理模型（32B，底座Qwen2.5），多阶段SFT+RL与长思维链，对接WiNEX医院流程；技术报告和代码已公开，权重未核验可下载
items.summary_en: Winning Health's third medical reasoning model (32B on Qwen2.5) with multi-stage SFT+RL and WiNEX hospital integration; tech report and code are public, weights are not verified as downloadable.

items.name: 太一 (Taiyi)
items.summary_zh: 大连理工DUTIR的中英双语生物医学大模型，底座Qwen-7B，覆盖问答、医患对话、报告生成与信息抽取等

items.summary_en: Second Taiyi open biomedical model, moving from Qwen-7B to GLM4-9B with tighter data filters and task instructions; the official replacement for Taiyi-1.

items.name: 麒麟-Med (Qilin-Med)
items.summary_zh: 多阶段知识注入的中文医疗LLM（CPT+SFT+DPO，底座Baichuan-7B），发布约3GB ChiMed语料，可再加RAG。arXiv PDF 署名北京大学、港科大（广州）等
items.summary_en: Multi-stage Chinese medical LLM (CPT+SFT+DPO on Baichuan-7B) releasing the ~3GB ChiMed corpus, optionally with RAG. arXiv PDF authors at Peking University and HKUST (Guangzhou) et al.
orgs_en: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) et al.

items.name: ChiMed-GPT
items.summary_zh: 中科大等在Ziya-v2上做继续预训练+SFT+RLHF的中文医疗大模型，覆盖抽取、问答与多轮对话
items.summary_en: USTC Chinese medical LLM continued from Ziya-v2 with pretraining, SFT, and RLHF for extraction, QA, and multi-turn dialogue.
orgs_en: University of Science and Technology of China

items.name: Apollo
items.summary_zh: 中大深圳FreedomIntelligence的多语种医疗LLM（含中文），配套ApolloCorpus与XMedBench
orgs: 香港中文大学(深圳)，深圳市大数据研究院
items.summary_en: FreedomIntelligence multilingual medical LLM (including Chinese) with ApolloCorpus and XMedBench.
orgs_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

orgs: 华南理工大学，广东省数字孪生人重点实验室

items.name: ClinicalGPT

orgs_en: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

items.name: 讯飞星火医疗

items.summary_en: Closed iFlytek medical LLM (Spark Medical X1/X2) behind Zhiyi Assistant and Xiaoyi; no public weights, listed as an industry baseline.

items.name: 腾讯混元医疗

items.name: YaTCM
items.title_zh: YaTCM 中药方剂–成分–靶点库
items.summary_zh: 约1813首方、6220味药、4.7万天然产物及靶点/通路分析工具；南开官网当前403，核验走开放论文
items.summary_en: About 1,813 prescriptions, 6,220 herbs, and 47k natural products with target/pathway tools. Nankai site currently returns 403; verify via the open-access paper.

items.name: TCMBank
items.title_zh: TCMBank 中药–成分–靶点–疾病库
items.summary_zh: 可下载的大规模中药–成分–靶点–疾病关系库，含文献自动抽取后人工核对的持续更新模块
items.summary_en: Large downloadable herb–ingredient–target–disease resource with literature-mining updates after manual checks.

items.name: ITCM
items.title_zh: ITCM 整合中医药与药效转录组平台
items.summary_zh: 整合多方剂/药材/成分/靶点，并提供496个中药成分的1488条药理转录谱；成分表达数据另见Synapse
items.summary_en: Integrated formula/herb/ingredient/target platform plus 1,488 pharmacotranscriptomic profiles for 496 TCM ingredients (expression data also on Synapse).

items.name: DCABM-TCM
items.title_zh: DCABM-TCM 中药入血成分与代谢物库
items.summary_zh: 文献挖掘的方剂/草药入血原型与代谢物及其检测条件（约1816个有结构入血成分）
items.summary_en: Literature-mined blood constituents and metabolites of TCM prescriptions and herbs, with experimental detection conditions (~1,816 structured absorbed constituents).

items.name: CMAUP
items.title_zh: CMAUP 有用植物集体分子活性库
items.summary_zh: BIDD的有用植物（含中药）多靶点活性、通路与疾病景观库，2024版扩展功能与关联信息，站点可下载
items.summary_en: BIDD landscape of multi-target activities, pathways, and diseases for useful plants including TCM herbs; 2024 update, downloadable from the official site.

items.name: SuperTCM
orgs: Development Research Center of the State Council
items.title_zh: SuperTCM 中药生物文化数据库
items.summary_zh: Charité团队整合药典与多源数据的中药–物种–成分–靶点–通路–疾病库（约6516味药）；官网tcm.charite.de已无法解析
items.summary_en: Charité biocultural TCM resource linking drugs, botanical species, ingredients, targets, KEGG pathways, and diseases (~6,516 drugs). Official tcm.charite.de no longer resolves.

items.name: TCMAnalyzer
items.title_zh: TCMAnalyzer 中药化学信息学分析平台
items.summary_zh: 中山大学RCDD的方剂/药材/成分网络分析与骨架检索服务（约1493方、618味药）；官网rcdd.org.cn当前超时
items.summary_en: RCDD chemo-/bioinformatics service for formula/herb/ingredient networks and scaffold search (~1,493 formulas, 618 herbs). Official rcdd.org.cn currently times out.

items.name: TCM-Mesh
items.title_zh: TCM-Mesh 中药网络药理学分析库
items.summary_zh: 草药–化合物–基因–疾病网络与毒副作用记录（约6235味药）；官网当前403，核验走开放论文
items.summary_en: Herb–compound–gene–disease network with toxicity/side-effect records (~6,235 herbs). Official portal currently returns 403; verify via the open paper.

items.name: TCMGeneDIT
orgs: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
items.title_zh: TCMGeneDIT 中药–基因–疾病文本挖掘库
items.summary_zh: 从文献挖掘中药、基因、疾病、功效与成分关联，并接入通路与PPI；官网tcm.lifescience.ntu.edu.tw已无法解析
items.summary_en: Text-mined associations among TCM, genes, diseases, effects, and ingredients, with pathway and PPI links. Official NTU site no longer resolves.

items.name: CVDHD
orgs: Beijing National Laboratory for Molecular Sciences
State Key Laboratory of Rare Earth Materials Chemistry and Application
items.title_zh: CVDHD 心血管病本草数据库
items.summary_zh: 面向心血管病的本草化合物三维结构、靶点与通路库，用于虚拟筛选与网络药理；原北大站点当前超时
items.summary_en: Cardiovascular herbal database of 3D compound structures, targets, and pathways for virtual screening and network pharmacology. Original Peking University site currently times out.

items.name: TM-MC
orgs: Korea Research Institute of Bioscience and Biotechnology
items.title_zh: TM-MC 东北亚传统药物成分库
items.summary_zh: 韩国韩医学研究院从文献抽取的东北亚药材–化合物库；2015初版约536种药材，2024的2.0扩到约3.4万化合物；官网当前超时
items.summary_en: KIOM literature-derived Northeast Asian medicinal-material–compound database; the 2015 release covers ~536 materials, and the 2024 2.0 paper expands to ~34k compounds. Official site currently times out.

items.name: CMB
items.title_zh: CMB 中文综合医学评测（Exam + Clin）
items.summary_zh: 中大深圳FreedomIntelligence的中文医疗综合基准：CMB-Exam约28万题+CMB-Clin复杂病案，中医论文里最常见的西医/综合对照榜
items.summary_en: FreedomIntelligence comprehensive Chinese medical benchmark (CMB-Exam ~280k items plus CMB-Clin cases); the most common non-TCM comparison board in TCM LLM papers.

items.name: CMExam
items.title_zh: CMExam 中文执业医师考试评测集
items.summary_zh: 源自国家医学考试的中文医考题（约6.8万），带多维标注，常被中文医疗/中医LLM当知识回忆对照
items.summary_en: Chinese medical licensing-exam set (~68k annotated items) used as a knowledge-recall baseline by Chinese medical and TCM LLMs.

items.name: Huatuo-26M
items.title_zh: Huatuo-26M 大规模中文医疗问答
items.summary_zh: 目前最大的开源中文医疗QA（约2600万对），含百科/图谱/问诊；精简版Huatuo-Lite常被拿来SFT或RAG
items.summary_en: Largest open Chinese medical QA resource (~26M pairs from encyclopedias, KGs, and consults); Huatuo-Lite is the usual SFT/RAG subset.

items.name: PromptCBLUE
items.title_zh: PromptCBLUE 中文医疗NLP指令化评测
items.summary_zh: 把CBLUE的16项中文医疗NLP任务改写成生成式指令，CCKS-2023评测任务，中文医疗LLM早期统一榜之一
items.summary_en: CBLUE's 16 Chinese medical NLP tasks rewritten as generative instructions; an early unified Chinese medical LLM leaderboard (CCKS 2023).

items.name: DISC-Med-SFT
items.title_zh: DISC-Med-SFT 医疗对话指令数据
items.summary_zh: 复旦DISC配套的约47万条医疗对话SFT（图谱三元组+真实问诊重构），不含偏好数据
items.summary_en: Fudan DISC medical-dialogue SFT set (~470k examples from KG triples and reconstructed consults; no preference data).

items.name: ChiMed (Qilin)
items.title_zh: ChiMed 中文医疗多阶段语料（Qilin-Med）
items.summary_zh: Qilin-Med发布的约3GB中文医疗语料（CPT/SFT/DPO），与预训练集ChiMed 2.0不是同一资源
items.summary_en: Qilin-Med's ~3GB Chinese medical corpus (CPT/SFT/DPO); not the same resource as the ChiMed 2.0 pretraining set.

items.name: cMedQA
items.title_zh: cMedQA v1 中文社区医疗问答
items.summary_zh: 从中文健康社区抓取的问答匹配集（仓库表：约 5.4 万问 / 10.2 万答，非商用研究）；论文 DOI 与 README 对得上，后续版本见 cMedQA2
items.summary_en: Chinese community medical QA-matching set (repo table ~54k questions / 102k answers; non-commercial research). Paper DOI matches the README; see cMedQA2 for the later release.

items.name: cMedQA2
items.title_zh: cMedQA2 中文社区医疗问答
items.summary_zh: 中文医疗论坛问答（约10.8万问/20万答），扁鹊语料和后续SFT常把它当作源数据
items.summary_en: Chinese community medical QA (~108k questions / 200k answers), a common source for BianQue-style SFT mixtures.

items.name: MedDialog
items.title_zh: MedDialog 中英医疗对话
items.summary_zh: 大规模医患对话（中文约110万场），中文医疗多轮问诊微调的常用源数据
items.summary_en: Large doctor–patient dialogue corpus (about 1.1M Chinese encounters) used for multi-turn Chinese medical fine-tuning.

items.name: CMeKG
items.title_zh: CMeKG 中文医学知识图谱
items.summary_zh: 覆盖疾病、药物、症状等的中文医学KG，本草/华驼和ChatGLM-Med的指令数据主要来源；原门户不稳，核验走工具仓
items.summary_en: Chinese medical knowledge graph of diseases, drugs, and symptoms; main source for BenCao/HuaTuo and ChatGLM-Med instruction data. Official portal is unstable; verify via the tools repo.

items.name: CBLUE
items.title_zh: CBLUE 中文生物医学语言理解评测
items.summary_zh: 中文生物医学NLU总榜（NER/关系/诊断归一化/分类等），PromptCBLUE的源任务集；天池有提交入口
items.summary_en: Chinese biomedical NLU benchmark (NER, relations, diagnosis normalization, classification); the source-task suite behind PromptCBLUE, with a Tianchi submission portal.

items.name: IMCS-21
items.title_zh: IMCS-21 智能医疗问诊对话
items.summary_zh: 约4116场儿科在线问诊，带实体/意图/症状/报告标注，后接入CBLUE四任务
items.summary_en: About 4,116 pediatric online consults annotated for entities, intents, symptoms, and reports; later wired into four CBLUE dialogue tasks.

items.name: webMedQA
items.title_zh: webMedQA 在线医疗咨询问答
items.summary_zh: 从健康咨询网站收集的中文非事实型医问（约6.3万问，1正4负答案），早期中文医疗QA常用源
items.summary_en: Early Chinese non-factoid medical QA from health-consult sites (~63k questions, one positive and four negative answers each).

items.name: KNApSAcK KAMPO
orgs: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
items.title_zh: KNApSAcK KAMPO 汉方处方与生药库
items.summary_zh: 奈良先端大整理的汉方公开库（约1581处方、278生药），生命科学数据库档案可下载
items.summary_en: NAIST Kampo public database (~1,581 formulas, 278 crude drugs), downloadable from the NBDC life-science archive.

items.name: Korean Medicine Embedding Dataset
items.title_zh: 韩医领域嵌入对比学习数据
items.summary_zh: 从韩医术语与本体构造的query–positive–negatives（约11.3万对），用于BGE-M3等检索微调
items.summary_en: Query–positive–negatives (~113k pairs) built from Korean-medicine terms and an ontology, for embedding fine-tunes such as BGE-M3.

items.name: OASIS (KIOM)
items.title_zh: OASIS 韩国传统医学信息门户
items.summary_zh: 韩国韩医学研究院的传统医学文献与资源门户，可检索韩医论文与本草资料
items.summary_en: KIOM traditional-medicine literature portal for Korean-medicine papers and herbal resources.

items.name: 儿童流感中成药推荐系统（KG+LLM）
items.summary_zh: 整合权威指南构建儿童流感中成药知识图谱并与LLM集成（JMIR Preprints预印本）
items.summary_en: Knowledge graph of Chinese patent medicines for pediatric influenza built from authoritative guidelines and integrated with an LLM (JMIR Preprints).
items.name_en: Pediatric influenza Chinese patent-medicine recommender (KG + LLM)

items.name: AI驱动中医诊断智能化综述（JTCMS）
items.summary_zh: 综述多模态融合与大模型在中医四诊智能化中的应用、挑战与展望（JTCMS正式发表）
items.venue: Journal of Traditional Chinese Medical Sciences
items.summary_en: Survey on multimodal fusion and LLMs for intelligent four-diagnosis in TCM: applications, challenges and outlook (JTCMS).

items.name: Beyond the Poetic Bard（中医AI翻译评论）
items.summary_zh: 讨论生成式AI翻译中医文本的精确性、认识论与医学语境局限（Translation Review）
items.summary_en: Beyond the Poetic Bard: a perspective on accuracy, epistemology, and medical-context limits of generative-AI translation of TCM texts (Translation Review).

items.name: RAG+LoRA 中医执照考试推理架构
items.summary_zh: RAG+LoRA生成式架构，构建台湾中医师执照考试11,476题（2005–2025）数据集，准确率61.0%→89.0%+（Future Internet）
items.summary_en: RAG+LoRA generative architecture with an 11,476-item Taiwan TCM licensing-exam dataset (2005-2025), raising accuracy from 61.0% to 89.0%+ (Future Internet, MDPI).

items.name: 从大语言模型到智能体（兰州大学学报医学版综述）
items.summary_zh: 以「大模型→智能体」演进为主线的中医临床辅助诊疗中文系统综述，梳理研究进展、关键问题与方向（兰州大学学报(医学版) 2026;52(4):49-57）
items.summary_en: Chinese-language systematic review organized around the LLM-to-agent transition for TCM clinical assisted diagnosis and treatment (J. Lanzhou Univ. Med. Sci. 2026;52(4):49-57).

items.name: 人工智能驱动下的中医智能诊疗研究进展与挑战
items.summary_zh: 以中医辨治六步程式为骨架的全链路（四诊-辨证-处方-疗效预测）中文综述，对照监督/无监督/强化/深度学习范式（上海中医药杂志 2026;60(1)）
items.summary_en: Chinese review structured on the six-step TCM diagnosis-treatment chain (four diagnoses, pattern differentiation, prescription, outcome prediction), contrasting supervised/unsupervised/RL/deep-learning paradigms (Shanghai J. TCM 2026;60(1)).

items.name: 多模态大模型驱动舌脉面诊智能化综述（Springer 书章）
items.summary_zh: 唯一以「多模态LLM×四诊感知」为题的综述性文本，覆盖舌/脉/面诊智能化（Springer CCIS 会议书章，评审强度低于期刊）
items.venue: Communications in Computer and Information Science (Springer)
orgs: University of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
items.summary_en: The only review text dedicated to multimodal-LLM-driven tongue, pulse, and facial diagnosis in TCM (Springer CCIS book chapter; weaker peer review than journals).

items.name: AI in TCM: Unraveling Herbal Medicine's Mechanisms（Research）
items.summary_zh: 主张AI从相关分析范式走向重建证候辨证与方剂配伍生物逻辑的药材机制中心宽口径综述（Research 2026;9:1224）
items.summary_en: Broad AI-in-TCM review arguing AI should move beyond correlational analysis toward reconstructing the biological logic of syndrome differentiation and formula compatibility (Research 2026;9:1224).

items.name: Deep learning in TCM（J Integr Med）
items.summary_zh: 深度学习单技术线综述：医学影像、药材物质研究、数据挖掘等应用实例（J Integr Med 2026;24(4):471-480）
items.summary_en: Single-technology review of deep learning in TCM: medical imaging, herbal material research, data mining (J. Integr. Med. 2026;24(4):471-480).

items.name: The integration of machine learning into TCM（J Pharm Anal）
items.summary_zh: 机器学习×中医整合综述：诊断客观化与机制阐释两条线（J Pharm Anal 2025;15(8):101157）
items.summary_en: Review of machine-learning integration into TCM along diagnostic objectification and mechanism-elucidation lines (J. Pharm. Anal. 2025;15(8):101157).

items.name: 古籍知识图谱×多智能体融合综述（Chin Med）
items.summary_zh: 古籍KG构建（术语统一、数据标准化）挑战-展望型综述，首次把multi-agent写入中医古籍议题（Chin Med 2025;20:168）
items.summary_en: Challenges-and-prospects review of knowledge-graph construction over ancient TCM classics, first to frame multi-agent convergence in this area (Chin. Med. 2025;20:168).

items.name: AI empowers the innovation of TCM（J Integr Med 评论）
items.summary_zh: 单作者评论性综述：古籍挖掘、诊疗标准化、药物研发周期三痛点×AI（J Integr Med 2026）
items.summary_en: Single-author perspective on AI for TCM innovation: classics mining, diagnosis standardization, drug R&D cycles (J. Integr. Med. 2026).

items.name: AI and Big Data in TCM Standardization and Internationalization（Chin Med Cult）
items.summary_zh: AI/大数据助力中医标准化与国际化评论（Chin Med Cult 2026, ahead of print）
items.summary_en: Perspective on AI and big data for TCM standardization and internationalization (Chin. Med. Cult. 2026, ahead of print).

items.name: AI for Spleen-Stomach Disorders in TCM（Curr Med Sci）
items.summary_zh: 单病种（脾胃病）KG+智能诊疗综述：「症状-证候-疾病-方剂」框架的知识工程化（Curr Med Sci 2025;45(6):1348-1357）
orgs: Hubei Provincial Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_en: Single-disease-area (spleen-stomach) review of KG plus intelligent diagnosis/treatment with a symptom-syndrome-disease-formula framework (Curr. Med. Sci. 2025;45(6)).

items.name: 人工智能赋能中医数字化诊断：现状与挑战（中华中医药学刊）
items.summary_zh: 中文短篇综述：AI在海量数据处理、辅助诊断、疾病预测的应用现状与数据质量/可解释性/理论融合三挑战（北大核心，题录级）
items.summary_en: Short Chinese review of AI-empowered digital TCM diagnosis: applications, data-quality, interpretability, and theory-integration challenges (bibliographic record only).

items.name: 人工智能实现中医四诊的发展现状、问题及解决路径（中华中医药学刊）
items.summary_zh: 四诊AI客观化现状-问题-路径分析：面舌采集、电子鼻、脉象传感、四诊合参融合度低（北大核心，题录级）
items.summary_en: Short Chinese review of AI-based four-diagnosis objectification: face/tongue acquisition, electronic nose, pulse sensing, and low fusion of multi-diagnosis data (bibliographic record only).

items.name: Intelligent Question-Answering Systems in Healthcare（Healthcare，邻近）
items.summary_zh: 2018-2025医疗QA综述+CiteSpace计量，明确含中医方剂开发应用场景（邻近综述，非TCM专用）
items.summary_en: Adjacent review (not TCM-specific): 2018-2025 healthcare QA survey with CiteSpace bibliometrics, explicitly covering TCM formula-development scenarios (Healthcare 2025).

items.name: 医疗领域的大型语言模型综述（智能系统学报，邻近）
items.summary_zh: 中文医疗LLM通用综述（训练流程/策略/场景/挑战），与中医LLM综述圈属母子集关系（邻近）
items.summary_en: Adjacent Chinese general survey of medical LLMs (training pipeline, strategies, scenarios, challenges), a superset-context reference for TCM LLM surveys.

items.name: 医学大语言模型的研发与应用系统综述（智能系统学报，邻近）
items.summary_zh: 系统综述129个医学专用LLM（截至2024-06）+4类临床应用研究；系统检索协议方法学可比（邻近）
items.summary_en: Adjacent systematic review of 129 medical-domain LLMs (to 2024-06) and four clinical application categories; methodologically comparable search protocol.

items.name: LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems for Clinical Workflows（ACL 2026，邻近）
items.summary_zh: 工作流级多智能体综述+四层评测栈（safety/process/outcome/operations）；无TCM交集但过程评测主张方法学同构（邻近）
items.summary_en: Adjacent ACL 2026 survey of workflow-level multi-agent clinical systems with a four-layer evaluation stack; no TCM coverage but methodologically isomorphic process-evaluation claims.

items.name: 仲景（CMtMedQA 线，Yang et al.）
items.summary_zh: 与 Kang 系 ZhongJingGPT 同名不同源的中医大模型：Ziya-LLaMA-13B 全流程 CPT+SFT+RLHF，基于约 7 万条真实多轮医患对话 CMtMedQA（AAAI 2024；注意与 Tsinghua Sci Technol 的 ZhongJingGPT 无作者与工件交集）
items.summary_en: ZhongJing (CMtMedQA line, Yang et al.): a TCM LLM distinct from the Kang-line ZhongJingGPT—full CPT+SFT+RLHF pipeline on Ziya-LLaMA-13B over ~70K real multi-turn doctor-patient dialogues (AAAI 2024).

items.name: RACE-Align
items.summary_zh: 检索增强+CoT 式 DPO 的轻量中医对齐模型（Qwen3-1.7B），探索小模型对齐路线。arXiv PDF 署名上海科技大学、河南大学与辽宁中医药大学
items.summary_en: RACE-Align: retrieval-augmented, CoT-style DPO alignment of a compact Qwen3-1.7B for TCM reasoning. arXiv PDF authors at ShanghaiTech, Henan University, and Liaoning University of TCM.
orgs_en: Liaoning University of Traditional Chinese Medicine

items.name: 树状自反思检索中医问答
items.summary_zh: 树状组织语料+自反思检索的中医 QA 方法（Frontiers in Medicine 2026）
items.summary_en: Tree-organized self-reflective retrieval for TCM question answering (Frontiers in Medicine 2026).
items.name_en: Tree-organized self-reflective retrieval for TCM QA

items.name: GPT vs ERNIE 中医文化背景对比研究
orgs: College of Engineering, Boston University, Boston, MA, USA.
items.summary_zh: 以文化背景为框架对比 GPT 与 ERNIE 在中医任务上的表现（J Integr Complement Med 2024）
items.summary_en: A culture-framed comparison of GPT versus ERNIE on TCM tasks (J. Integr. Complement. Med. 2024).

items.name: Functional structure model of human body and Yinyang-Wuxing equations
items.summary_zh: 早期以微分方程刻画人体五行功能子系统与经络自组织。
orgs: University of Science and Technology of China
items.summary_en: Historical anchor: Functional structure model of human body and Yinyang-Wuxing equations.

items.name: A computer model of the “five elements” theory of traditional Chinese medicine
items.summary_zh: 布尔网络模拟五行吸引子及扰动对稳态的影响。
